camel_example: aliyun mts QueryMediaListByURL --region cn-hangzhou --IncludeSummaryList true --FileURLs 'http://example-bucket-0000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4' --IncludeSnapshotList true --IncludeMediaInfo true --IncludePlayList true
description_en: Queries media files by their Object Storage Service (OSS) file URLs
description_zh: 使用OSS文件地址查询媒体
kebab_example: aliyun mts query-media-list-by-url --file-urls http://example-bucket-0000.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4 --include-play-list true --include-snapshot-list true --include-media-info true --include-summary-list true --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryMediaListByURL

parameters.help_en:
The URLs of the media files that you want to query. To obtain the URL of a media file, log on to the MPS console, choose Media Management > Media List, find the media file, and then click Manage in the Actions column. On the Get Transcoding URL tab, you can obtain the URL of the media file. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). You can query a maximum of 10 URLs at a time.

The URL must be compliant with RFC 3986. The URL must be encoded in UTF-8, and reserved characters must be URL-encoded. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html. The URL can be up to 3,200 bytes in length.

Only OSS HTTP URLs are supported. CDN and HTTPS URLs are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的媒体文件地址，可以登录MPS控制台，通过媒体管理 > 媒体列表找到需要查询的媒体文件，单击操作列管理，在获取转码地址页签中获取媒体文件地址。用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多查询10个。
URL遵循RFC 3986（UTF8编码，并对保留字符进行URLEncode。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html），不超过3200字节。

仅支持OSS HTTP地址，不支持CDN地址和HTTPS地址
